Completed the A-M11-B control research assignment. The native Goal was active before research and completed only after the required artifacts were saved.

- [draft.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/control/research/draft.md): full synthesis and dispositions for P1–P6.
- [discovery.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/control/research/discovery.md): frozen pre-plan discovery.
- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/control/research/source-map.json) and [source index](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/control/research/sources/index.md): 15 sources with locators and evidence notes.
- [revealed-plan.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/control/research/revealed-plan.md) and [critic review](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/control/research/critic-review.md).

Artifact checks confirmed all P1–P6 dispositions and source-note references are present, and discovery/source-map predate the plan reveal. No runtime, security, curator, or benchmark validations were run; those are proposed in the draft.

The Goal took about 12 minutes. A zero-byte `/tmp/not-used` scratch file was briefly created during draft transfer and removed; it does not remain.
